rag.text:
Test: TC-541 — Global - Skills - Resynchronization with Tempo
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-9 Global - Skills
Labels: be-enterprise

Steps:
1. Navigate to Tempo -> Settings -> Staff/Roles
   Data: _Tempo_ should be installed
   Expected: Team Roles tab is displayed.
2. Add new team role passing this set of data
   Data: skillName1: TC-541 Tempo Skill 1
   Expected: New team role is added
3. Add another team role passing this set of data
   Data: skillName2: TC-541 Tempo Skill 2
   Expected: New team role is added
4. Navigate to BP Administration -> Skills tab and click Synchronize with Tempo button
   Expected: Skills tab is displayed.

"TC-541 Tempo Skill 1" and "TC-541 Tempo Skill 2" are displayed on the list with green Tempo lozenge
5. Hover over Resynchronize button next to skillName
   Data: skillName1: TC-541 Tempo Skill 1
   Expected: Resynchronize button is grayed out. Tooltip with message "Skill cannot be re-synchronized with Tempo" is displayed.
6. Edit skill with this set of data
   Data: skillName1: TC-541 Tempo Skill edited
description: TC-541 Tempo Skill edited
   Expected: Skill TC-541 Tempo Skill 1 is changed to new name TC-541 Tempo Skill edited and description is set to  TC-541 Tempo Skill edited 



Tempo sync status is changed from Synced to Overwritten
7. Edit skill with this set of data
   Data: skillName2: TC-541 Tempo Skill 2 edited on BP level
   Expected: Skill TC-541 Tempo Skill 2 is changed to new name TC-541 Tempo Skill 2 edited on BP level

Tempo sync status is changed from Synced to Overwritten
8. Navigate to Tempo -> Settings -> Staff/Roles
   Expected: Team Roles tab is displayed.

Roles  "TC-541 Tempo Skill 1" and "TC-541 Tempo Skill 2" are still displayed on the list. Changes made in BP level are not displayed in Tempo.
9. Click on roleName and set newName
   Data: roleName: TC-541 Tempo Skill 1
newName: TC-541 Tempo Skill resynchronized
   Expected: Changes are saved
10. Navigate to BP Administration -> Skills tab
   Expected: Skills tab is displayed.

"TC-541 Tempo Skill edited" is displayed on the list
11. Click Resynchronize button next to skillName
   Data: skillName: TC-541 Tempo Skill edited
   Expected: Synchronization is completed.

"TC-541 Tempo Skill resynchronized" is displayed on the list with green Tempo lozenge
12. Click Synchronize with Tempo button
   Expected: FolLowing skills are displayed:

* "TC-541 Tempo Skill resynchronized" is displayed on the list with green Tempo lozenge 'Synced'
* "TC-541 Tempo Skill 2 edited on BP level" is displayed on the list with violet tempo lozenge 'Overwritten'
